title: Exploring the Neuroprotective Effects of Walnut (Juglans regia L.) Against Cognitive Impairment in Alzheimer's Disease Through the MAPK-mTORC1-TFEB-Mediated Endolysosomal Pathway: A Network Pharmacology and Molecular Docking Approach.
authors: Lin, Chih-Ting; Chen, Kuan-Tso; Hung, Yu-Chiang
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究核桃成分对阿尔茨海默病的神经保护机制，虽涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a complex neurodegenerative disorder with multifaceted pathogenesis. Given the clinical need for multi-target interventions, this study elucidated the neuroprotective mechanisms of walnut (Juglans regia L.) against AD-related cognitive impairment. Methods: We characterized 25 bioactive constituents (fatty acids and ellagitannins) and constructed a protein-protein interaction (PPI) network. GO/KEGG enrichment, integrated with Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA), deciphered pharmacological pathways, followed by molecular docking to evaluate ligand-target binding thermodynamics. Network analysis revealed that walnut phytochemicals synergistically modulate the MAPK-mTORC1-TFEB-mediated endolysosomal homeostasis pathway. Molecular docking indicated that ellagitannins (strictinin, pedunculagin, tellimagrandin I) exhibit robust affinities for upstream RAS/RAF/MEK kinases, suppressing pro-pathogenic signaling. Concurrently, gallic acid targeted ABCA1 and TFEB, promoting TFEB activation and nuclear translocation to enhance beta-amyloid clearance and lysosomal biogenesis. This study provides evidence that walnut attenuates AD pathology through "multi-component" reinforcement of the endolysosomal defense system, establishing a mechanistic foundation for walnut as a promising functional food.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）是一种具有多层面发病机制的复杂神经退行性疾病。鉴于临床对多靶点干预的需求，本研究阐明了核桃（Juglans regia L.）对抗AD相关认知障碍的神经保护机制。方法：我们表征了25种生物活性成分（脂肪酸和鞣花单宁），并构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。通过GO/KEGG富集分析，结合Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA)，解析了药理学通路，随后采用分子对接评估配体-靶标结合热力学。网络分析显示，核桃植物化学物质协同调节MAPK-mTORC1-TFEB介导的内溶酶体稳态通路。分子对接表明，鞣花单宁（strictinin、pedunculagin、tellimagrandin I）对上游RAS/RAF/MEK激酶表现出强亲和力，抑制促病理性信号传导。同时，没食子酸靶向ABCA1和TFEB，促进TFEB激活及核转位，以增强β-淀粉样蛋白清除和溶酶体生物发生。本研究提供证据表明，核桃通过“多组分”强化内溶酶体防御系统来减轻AD病理，为核桃作为有前景的功能性食品奠定了机制基础。
